prompt: Camera completely still. Straight away the woman on the sofa, still in her olive parka, reads her phone, its cool light flickering faintly on her face. Her expression slowly changes from tired to stunned; she slowly lowers the mug of tea in her other hand to her lap and stops moving, just staring at the screen. On the window behind her, raindrops run down the glass in thin trails. The table lamp glows steadily and the candle flame on the coffee table flickers softly. She says nothing; the room is quiet. Sound: rain against the window, a faint tick of the radiator, near silence. Warm lamplight against cold grey window light, real home interior.
